response.claim_ceiling: Scratch diagnostic only. Supported ceiling: (i) valid distinct CPTP Choi objects for the terrain set; (ii) one tested base/mirror pair is related (rho~0.76) but not strictly isomorphic, with coarser channel-kind partition; (iii) tiny Choi-distance meta-graph is non-uniform on this designed set; (iv) frozen Choi-to-edge packing can populate H2/H3(O) candidates and fail H4 with controls. Not admitted: axes 7-12, IGT games, exceptional symmetry action, natural Albert map, geometry/curvature, or any physics bridge.

merge_value.best_use: Use UP-110 as the object/relation layer and Codex as the algebraic stress-test layer in one controlled next sim, with explicit null models and blocked consumers.
merge_value.do_not_merge_into: Do not fuse 'Choi field exists' + 'H3(O) packing survives' into 'exceptional field symmetry', 'IGT admitted', or 'axes 7-12 live'. Keep ceilings separate and low.
merge_value.honest_joint_claim: A finite multi-engine Choi field can be built, scored, and packed into candidate Albert/Jordan objects that pass H2/H3 and fail H4 under frozen packing — still diagnostic only.
merge_value.pipeline: UP-110 supplies field objects (per-engine Choi matrices) and a pairwise Choi meta-graph; Codex supplies a frozen packing target into H2(O)/H3(O) with Jordan-pattern gates and negative controls.
merge_value.shared_object: Choi / superoperator level as the right carrier for engines-as-objects.

next_sim.goal: Finite controlled sim that (1) builds a larger/parameterized channel ensemble, (2) defines several explicit Choi-level readout functionals, (3) measures base↔mirror correlation structure with probe ensembles and nulls, (4) builds Choi meta-graph centralities against null models, (5) feeds the same field into Codex-style H2/H3/H4 packing with existing negative controls.

Strict isomorphism A_i -> A_{i+6} for all six pairs (only one proxy pair tested).
That Choi entropy is the canonical mirror of Axis-1 mixedness, or that any specific Choi functional is the mirror map.
IGT as an actual game: no strategies, payoffs, information sets, equilibria, or FEP-linked utility — only an adjacency/centrality seed.
Exceptional algebras (O, H3(O), F4, E6/E7/E8) acting as field symmetries or governing the meta-graph.
Any natural/canonical Choi-to-octonion or Choi-to-Albert map.
Dimensional numerology as proof: dim O=8 between 4 and 16, or H3(O)=27 > 16, does not establish that multi-engine fields are H3(O)-native.
Intrinsic curvature / non-flat geometry of the engine field.
Generalization of rho~0.76 across probes, axes, channel ensembles, or larger n.
Depol centrality as a deep structural law rather than a small designed 8-terrain artifact.
Any Axis-0, bridge, manifold-physics, or runtime admission claim.

supported: Choi construction for the 8 terrain channels is mathematically standard and numerically sound (TP defect ~1e-16; full-Choi min distance 0.5211).
Mirror/Choi level is a genuine higher object relative to single-qubit states: base real dim 4 vs Choi 4x4 / real dim 16.
For the tested pair (base state mixedness under one probe vs Choi entropy), Spearman rho=0.762 is clearly not 1.0, so 'strictly isomorphic' fails.
Choi entropy groups exactly by channel kind (damp 0.929 / depol 1.805 / proj 1.121), so the mirror readout is coarser and channel-structural rather than an order-identical copy of the base ranking.
On this 8-node set, pairwise Choi-distance centralities are non-uniform (depol lower/more central than damp/proj).
Doc correction from 'strictly isomorphic' to 'related but not strictly isomorphic' is justified for the tested pair and is the right ratchet move.

Codex local probe: frozen Choi-to-edge packing can populate H2(O)/H3(O) candidates and reproduce the H2/H3 pass vs H4 fail Jordan pattern, with useful negative controls (sedenion fail, wrong Fano fail, identical-channel edge collapse, associative H4(R/C/H) pass).
Both artifacts correctly self-classify as scratch_diagnostic with promotion_allowed false / blocked downstream consumers.
response.verdict: UP-110 is a valid scratch-level seed: Choi objects are real CPTP higher objects, terrains separate, and the doc's strict A_i->A_{i+6} isomorphism is correctly weakened. The rho=0.762 + channel-kind grouping justify 'related but not strictly isomorphic' for the single tested pair only. Merge with Codex's H_n(O) packing probe is useful as a pipeline, not as admission. Exceptional-algebra, IGT-game, and axes 7-12 runtime claims remain unsupported.
weaknesses: UP-110 tests only one base/mirror pair; the doc claim is about six maps, not one scalar correlation.
Base mixedness is single-probe-dependent; no probe ensemble or probe-robustness control.
Mirror values are heavily tied (only 3 distinct Choi-entropy levels). Spearman on n=8 with ties is weak evidence and largely reflects the 3-kind design.
Channel-kind grouping is almost forced by the terrain table (only damp/depol/proj). It confirms coarseness but is not a deep discovery.
Centrality = row-sum of distances on 8 designed nodes; no null model (random CPTP, parameter-matched same-kind channels, label shuffles).
Gate band 0.5 < rho < 1.0 is a soft diagnostic band, not a mathematical isomorphism criterion.
Narrative overreach risk: phrases like 'IGT lives HERE' and 'exceptional algebras = the FIELD symmetry' exceed the measured seed.
Dimension story is motivational numerology, not a structure theorem.
Codex packing is frozen/non-canonical; survival under frozen packing is not natural-map evidence.
No control that mirror readouts preserve any algebraic structure beyond one rank correlation.
No multi-axis definition of what 'mirror of A_i' means operationally (entropy? spectrum? diamond distance? process fidelity? Choi purity?).
